newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Feb consumer prices up 0.4 pct -official.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Feb consumer prices up 0.4 pct -official.

text.p: Argentina's consumer prices rose 0.4 percent in February, compared with a 0.3 percent drop in February 1996 and a 0.5 percent rise in January this year, the Economy Ministry said Tuesday.
Wholesale prices fell 0.2 percent in February, versus a 0.1 percent decline in February last year and a 0.2 percent increase this January.
Consumer prices rose 0.9 percent in the 12 months to February. Wholesale prices increased by 2.1 percent over the same period.
No comparative figures were available for the previous 12-month period because of the introduction of a new index series last year.
